operation.name: GetNonGBVDashboardStatusCount
operation.query: SELECt stat.StatusName as DisplayName, COUNT(NONgbvmainid) as DisplayValue from NonGBVMain main inner join LK_GBVStatus stat on main.Status=stat.StatusID where stat.NonGBVStatus=1 and main.Deleted=0 group by [statusID],StatusName

operation.name: GetNonGBVDashboardTypeCount
operation.query: SELECt typ.Name as DisplayName, COUNT(NONgbvmainid) as DisplayValue from NonGBVMain main inner join LK_TypeOfGrievance typ on main.typeofgrievanceid=typ.typeofgrievanceid where main.Deleted=0 group by typ.name

operation.name: GetNonGBVDashboardTypeDelayedCount
operation.query: SELECt typ.Name as DisplayName, COUNT(NONgbvmainid) as DisplayValue from NonGBVMain main inner join LK_TypeOfGrievance typ on main.typeofgrievanceid=typ.typeofgrievanceid where main.Deleted=0 and Status<>5 and dateadd(DAY,14, [Date]) < getdate() group by typ.name

operation.name: GetGBVDashboardStatusCount
operation.query: SELECt stat.StatusName as DisplayName, COUNT(gbvmainid) as DisplayValue from GBVMain main inner join LK_GBVStatus stat on main.Status=stat.StatusID where stat.GBVStatus=1 and main.Deleted=0 group by [statusID],StatusName

operation.name: GetNonGBVDashboardTypeDelayedCount
operation.query: SELECt stat.StatusName as DisplayName, COUNT(gbvmainid) as DisplayValue from GBVMain main inner join LK_GBVStatus stat on main.Status=stat.StatusID where stat.GBVStatus=1 and main.Deleted=0 group by [statusID],StatusName

operation.name: GetGBVDashboardByCountyAll
operation.query: select CountieName +' - GBV' as DisplayName, count(*) as DisplayValue from GBVmain inner join tm_Counties on GBVmain.CountyID=intCountieid WHERE deleted=0 GROUP BY CountieName union select countiename+' - NGBV' as DisplayName, count(*) as DisplayValue from NonGBVMain inner join tm_Counties on NonGBVMain.CountyID=intCountieid WHERE deleted=0 GROUP BY CountieName order by DisplayName

operation.name: GetGBVDashboardByStatusAll
operation.query: select LK_GBVStatus.StatusName + ' (GBV)' as DisplayName, count(*) as DisplayValue from gbvmain inner join LK_GBVStatus on LK_GBVStatus.StatusID=gbvmain.Status where deleted=0 group by LK_GBVStatus.StatusName union select LK_GBVStatus.StatusName+ ' (NGBV)' as DisplayName, count(*) as DisplayValue from NonGBVMain inner join LK_GBVStatus on LK_GBVStatus.StatusID=nongbvmain.Status where deleted=0 group by LK_GBVStatus.StatusName order by DisplayName

operation.name: GetAvgToCloseByCountyAll
operation.query: select countiename + ' (GBV)' as DisplayName, (sum(datediff(day, date,lastmodificationtimestamp))/count(*)) as DisplayValue from gbvmain inner join tm_Counties on tm_Counties.intCountieid=GBVMain.CountyID where deleted=0 and status =5 --CLosed and LastModificationTimestamp is not null group by countiename union select countiename + ' (NGBV)'as DisplayLabel, (sum(datediff(day, date,lastmodificationtimestamp))/count(*)) as DisplayValue from nongbvmain inner join tm_Counties on tm_Counties.intCountieid=nonGBVMain.CountyID where deleted=0 and status =5 --CLosed and LastModificationTimestamp is not null group by countiename

operation.name: GetTypesOfReferral
operation.query: select ReferralServicesRecommended as DisplayName,count(*) as DisplayValue from GBVMain where deleted=0 and ReferralServicesRecommended<>'0' group by ReferralServicesRecommended

operation.name: GetSentToReferralService
operation.query: select 'Sent to referral service' as DisplayName,count(*) as DisplayValue from GBVMain where deleted=0 and ReferralServicesRecommended<>'0' union select 'Not Sent to referral service' as DisplayName,count(*) as DisplayValue from GBVMain where deleted=0 and ReferralServicesRecommended='0' Union select 'Total' as DisplayName,count(*) as DisplayValue from GBVMain where deleted=0

operation.name: GetGBVPerpetratorProject
operation.query: select 'Perpetrator Associated With Project' as DisplayName,count(*) as DisplayValue from GBVMain where deleted=0 and SuspectAssociatedWithProject=1 union select 'Perpetrator Not Associated With Project' as DisplayName,count(*) as DisplayValue from GBVMain where deleted=0 and SuspectAssociatedWithProject<>1 union select 'Total' as DisplayName,count(*) as DisplayValue from GBVMain where deleted=0
